briefing.headline: US-China model race intensifies as OpenAI and DeepSeek release frontier systems within 48 hours

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with multimodal agents showing emergent capabilities. Regulatory pressure mounts in both US and EU while compute constraints tighten globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced agentic reasoning. DeepSeek-V4 matches performance at lower cost. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus shows gains in long-context coherence.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and automotive environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra batches to Microsoft and xAI. TSMC reports 3nm yield improvements supporting next-gen training clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
